deflection_zh: 錢的事情要和大人商量，我們一起去問爸爸媽媽。

5-6: 告訴孩子：家裡的錢是大人會處理的事
說：沒錢的時候，還是有人會照顧你
不要讓孩子擔心大人的煩惱
一起說說：不買東西也可以快樂地玩
7-8: 簡單說明家裡的錢怎麼用、怎麼存
說明：有沒有錢，不代表一個人好不好
讓孩子知道可以說出擔心，不用一個人想
可以一起做不花錢的事，例如散步或畫畫

what_not_to_say: 不要說「我們好窮」或「我們快沒錢了」
不要把大人的壓力丟給孩子
不要拿別人家的條件來比較
author: claude-haiku

en.deflection: That's a worry to share with grown-ups. Let's ask mom or dad together, okay?

5-6: Tell your child: grown-ups take care of money at home.
Say: even when money is tight, people still take care of you.
Don't let your child worry about grown-up problems.
Talk about how you can have fun without buying things.
7-8: Briefly explain how the family's money is spent and saved.
Explain that having money doesn't decide whether a person is good.
Let them know they can share worries and don't have to think alone.
Do free things together, like walking or drawing.

what_not_to_say: Don't say 'we are so poor' or 'we're about to run out of money'.
Don't pass grown-up pressure on to your child.
Don't compare your family with other families.
